title: 都说欧洲疲软：央行行长却说在加速，增长超预期？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're going to go back out there right now with our colleague, Lisa Abramowitz, from Bloomberg's Reveillance, who brings us a conversation with the governor of the Austrian National Bank.
segments.zh: 现在我们将连线彭博社的同事丽莎·阿布拉莫维茨，她将带来与奥地利国家银行行长的对话。

segments.en: Lisa, it's great to see you. Go ahead.
segments.zh: 丽莎，很高兴见到你，请继续。

segments.en: It is great to see you, Joe. Thank you so much. It does appear like the sun is coming out, breaking through the clouds as we get some clarity from a Fed Chair, Kevin Worsh.
segments.zh: 我也很高兴见到你，乔，谢谢。随着美联储主席凯文·沃什的表态，似乎云开雾散，我们获得了一些清晰度。

segments.en: I am sitting here with someone who traveled a long, long way to come to the Grand Teton's of Martin Kocher.
segments.zh: 我身边这位是远道而来的马丁·科赫尔，他来到了大提顿山。

segments.en: He is the governor of the Austrian Central Bank. Thank you so much for being with us, Governor Kocher.
segments.zh: 他是奥地利中央银行行长。非常感谢您接受我们的采访，科赫尔行长。

segments.en: How is your takeaway from Kevin Worsh's speech? Do you think that the Fed Chair set the right tone at a pretty inflationary moment for the global economy?
segments.zh: 您对凯文·沃什的讲话有何看法？在全球经济面临通胀压力的时刻，您认为美联储主席的基调是否恰当？

segments.en: First of all, thanks for having me. It was very interesting to hear his assessment of the state of the economy in America.
segments.zh: 首先，感谢您的邀请。听他评估美国经济状况非常有趣。

segments.en: It was interesting to hear what he thinks drives growth and what kind of uncertainties and what kind of challenges are out there.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，他谈到了增长动力以及面临的不确定性和挑战。

segments.en: And he was very clear about the target, the 2% inflation target of the Federal Reserve and the commitment of the FOMC to deliver.
segments.zh: 他明确提到了美联储2%的通胀目标以及联邦公开市场委员会实现该目标的承诺。

segments.en: So I think it was a clarifying speech and interesting to listen to.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一次澄清性的讲话，值得一听。

segments.en: Just to give some perspective, central bankers from all over the world come here, like yourself, to hear what the Fed has to say, but also to talk with their colleagues.
segments.zh: 为了提供一些背景，来自世界各地的央行行长们，就像您一样，来到这里听取美联储的发言，同时也与同行交流。

segments.en: How important is it to European central bank bankers to hear what the Fed has to say or what the Fed has to do?
segments.zh: 对于欧洲央行行长来说，听取美联储的发言或了解其行动有多重要？

segments.en: In other words, how much is the Fed still central bankers to the world as it used to be called?
segments.zh: 换句话说，美联储是否仍然像过去那样，是全球央行的核心？

segments.en: It is, of course, a very important central bank.
segments.zh: 当然，它是一家非常重要的央行。
